verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies region choice. A release note names a specific region (UAE Central, Abu Dhabi) where a model can be imported into OCI Generative AI, and a community comment says Oracle will build configurations in any region globally for customers with enough spend. Nothing documents choosing where your data is stored or any residency guarantee. Missing for 10: first-party docs on region selection for data storage, data-residency/sovereignty guarantees, a list of available regions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
